CommunityApplications.Profile: Community Apps templates maintained by Aurial. Currently: one app, **Strata AMD** — a template for the official ROCm builds of [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata), which runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model on AMD Radeon GPUs (RX 7000, RX 9000, Radeon AI PRO R9700, Ryzen AI Max) in Unraid. Template and Unraid problems: open an issue in this repository. Problems with Strata itself: https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues
